name: LunOS Official App Repository
purpose: Official catalog and package repository for applications distributed by the LunOS operating system.

packages.name: Beam HTTP
packages.description: Beam makes an HTTP request from the Terminal and shows status, timing, headers and body. Options: -X METHOD, -d text, -H "Name: Value", -i headers, -o file to save the body, -s body only. JSON responses are pretty-printed. Usage: beam <url> [options]
packages.shortDescription: HTTP requests from Terminal: status, headers, body, save to file.

versions.shortDescription: HTTP requests from Terminal: status, headers, body, save to file.

packages.name: Bytes View
packages.description: Bytes shows the raw bytes of any file as a hex + text dump with offsets (16 bytes per row). Usage: bytes <file> [max-bytes, default 512, max 8192]
packages.shortDescription: Hex + text dump of any file, right in the Terminal.

packages.name: Delta Compare
packages.description: Delta compares two text files line by line and shows what changed: lines marked - exist only in the first file, + only in the second, with a short summary. Exit code 1 when files differ, 0 when identical. Usage: delta <file-a> <file-b>
packages.shortDescription: Line-by-line file comparison with +/- change markers.

packages.shortDescription: Host reachability + latency probe with min/avg/max timings.

packages.name: Tide Editor
packages.description: Tide is a touch-first editor for the LunOS Terminal, written from scratch for LunOS. It now renders like modern code editors: syntax highlighting (Python, JavaScript, C/C++, Rust, Go, Java, HTML, CSS, JSON, Shell, Markdown, PHP, Ruby, SQL, Swift, Kotlin), language name in the header, and a permanent visible Exit button. On phones: tap the input, type with the on-screen keyboard, and control with Save, Exit, Find, Replace, ReplaceOne, Goto, First/Last, Cut/Paste, CopyAll/CopyWord, Undo/Redo, arrows/Home/End/PgUp/PgDn, Tab/Enter/Bksp/Del. Escape/Touch Esc Exit closes the editor (asking to save unsaved changes). Keyboard control also works: Ctrl+O writes, Ctrl+X/Escape exits, Ctrl+K/Ctrl+U cut & paste, Ctrl+W find, Ctrl+Backslash replaces all, Ctrl+G go to line, Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y undo/redo, Tab/Shift+Tab indent, Ctrl+/ comment, Ctrl+D duplicate, Ctrl+C shows cursor position.
packages.shortDescription: Tide editor: touch-first editor with syntax highlighting and safe Esc exit.
